**Mills' constant.**
There is a *least* Mills number.
references: [A prime-representing function](https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1947-53-06/S0002-9904-1947-08849-2/) by *W. H. Mills*, Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. **53** (1947), 604.
[Mills' constant is irrational](https://doi.org/10.1112/mtk.70027) by *Kota Saito*, Mathematika **71** (2025), no. 3, e70027, [arXiv:2404.19461](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.19461).
[Determining Mills' Constant ..](https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/journals/JIS/VOL8/Caldwell/caldwell78.pdf) by *Chris K. Caldwell and Yuanyou Cheng*, J. Integer Seq. **8** (2005), Article 05.4.1.
